logic_errors.finding: Permanent safe corridors defeat the traffic challenge. Traffic stays exactly at lane centers, while continuous steering lets the player remain at x=0.4 indefinitely. That position avoids every possible traffic car and earns near-miss rewards from center-lane cars without further steering. Increasing cruise speed cannot remove this unlimited score/nitro farming strategy.
logic_errors.recommendation: Adjust traffic placement or movement to prevent permanently safe lateral positions while retaining guaranteed escape routes. Add a long-run regression covering stationary inter-lane positions; unattended center-lane crashes do not cover this case.

suggestions.finding: The pause button is focused before render() enables it, so the intended focus transfer fails on start, resume and retry.
suggestions.recommendation: Enable/render the running controls before focusing pause, and assert the resulting activeElement in browser coverage.

suggestions.finding: The wave-spacing explanation accounts for only one contactLength, whereas the stronger parent oracle accounts for both entry and exit of the longitudinal contact zone.
suggestions.recommendation: Align the documented inequality with tests/manual/engine.cjs:144-149. Current spacing already satisfies that stronger check.

summary: Reviewed the whole candidate read-only, including runtime, helpers, tests and acceptance evidence. All 44 source hashes match the supplied manifest; dist runtime hashes match source. Parent evidence records 18 unit and 6 browser passes, but misses the permanent safe-corridor strategy. Tests were not rerun because boundary tests write fixtures.
